verdict.rationale: Riveter's own AI agents take delegated work: they build datasets from a natural-language prompt and answer single questions through an AI-researched agent loop (search_agent). These are task-specific agent calls, not a documented general-purpose in-product assistant, and the MCP material describes external assistants like Claude, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: a documented in-product conversational assistant that accepts arbitrary delegated tasks, UI-level assistant experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can build one from a natural-language prompt or a structured spec, and Riveter will generate the rows for you.
A search_agent call asks one question and gets one AI-researched answer back — the same agent loop that fills a single enrichment cell, without setting up an enrichment.
Riveter uses AI agents that interpret pages the way a person would, so the same configuration keeps working after a redesign.
